_comment: The flea market (DESIGN.md §10, Flea market), read by FleaTable and FleaMarket. unlock_level: the player level it opens at. refresh_minutes: new listings go up every this many real minutes (the clock runs while the game is closed; the same listings for everyone on the same clock). listings: per_refresh, how many new listings of each rarity go up each refresh (a fraction is a chance of one more: legendary 0.04 is one listing in 25 refreshes); category_weight, how much likelier (above 1) or rarer an item of a category is picked within its rarity (default 1); minutes [from, to] a listing stays up; spread [from, to], its price against the market price; condition [from, to], the share of their durability guns and armor come with; parts, the chance a gun comes with extra parts and how many [from, to]; stack [from, to], the share of a full stack stackable items come in; rating [from, to], the seller's rating out of 5; names, the made-up seller handles (a first part, a second part and sometimes two digits). drift: each item's market price is its worth (Selling.item_value()) times a multiplier that walks within min-max around center: every bucket_minutes one seeded step of up to speed (a share of the way to a bound), the walk being the sum of the last window steps, so it wanders and comes back, the same for everyone on the same clock; trend_hours: the price trend arrow compares against the price this long ago, showing a change above trend_threshold. pressure: buying a listing adds buy to that item's multiplier, putting one up takes sell off, at most max either way; it halves every half_life_hours. fee: listing costs base (a share of the asking price) up front, plus over for each 1.0 the asking price is above the market price (1.2 times: 0.2 × over more), at most max; never refunded. slots: base listings at unlock_level, one more every every levels. sale: how fast a listing sells by its price against the market price at listing: minutes, a curve of [price ratio, minutes] points (straight lines between them; under the first point as fast as it, over the last never), times a seeded random factor in spread; a listing stays up hours, then comes back unsold. floor: no listing is ever cheaper than the item's resale floor (Trading.resale_floor(): the best trader's top-loyalty price plus resale_floor in trading.json), the Wanted bonus included for anything a trader could want. banned: never listed and never for sale: these ids, categories and tags, secure containers, the boss uniques (bosses.json) and rounds with at least min_penetration.
